page_title: LIV 3-0 BRE | Liverpool v Brentford 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. It's a free kick to Brentford, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+4' Jurgen Klopp has decided to substitute Dominik Szoboszlai and he is replaced by James McConnell (Liverpool).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Trent Alexander-Arnold leaves the pitch and Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) comes on.
89' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

89' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Mark Flekken sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. Now Liverpool have a corner.
87' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
84' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luis Diaz (Liverpool) replacing Diogo Jota.
83' Substitution. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) on for Cody Gakpo.
83' The ball unexpectedly rebounds out to Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) on the edge of the box, but his attempt is lame and ends up well wide of the right post.
80' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

78' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header into the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. Good work from Brentford as they win a corner.
78' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
78' Brentford failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Brentford win a corner.
77' The ball is cleared after Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Brentford.
75' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brentford.
74' 3 - 0 Goal! Konstantinos Tsimikas plays a short, square pass into the path of Diogo Jota (Liverpool), who bends a shot straight into the right side of the goal to make it 3:0. Fabulous goal!
73' Here comes a substitution. Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) is brought on as a substitute for Mads Roerslev Rasmussen.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Yoane Wissa walks off the pitch to be replaced by Neal Maupay (Brentford).
72' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Mathias Jensen will be replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
71' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
70' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.
67' What a miss! The corner finds Christian Norgaard (Brentford) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
67' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

66' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee signals a corner kick to Brentford.
62' 2 - 0 Goal! A great cross from Dominik Szoboszlai finds Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), who scores with a simple header into an empty net. 2:0.
61' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
61' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
58' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Paul Tierney decides there was no infringement by Wataru Endo (Liverpool) and the game can continue.

56' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Wataru Endo (Liverpool) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
55' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
55' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul. Brentford are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
54' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
52' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
52' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

50' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) attempts to directly endanger the opponent's goal from a direct free kick just outside the box. He sends the ball under the crossbar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a great save. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
50' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and signals a foul after Joel Matip (Liverpool) brought his opponent down. Brentford earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
49' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) commits a foul during an attacking move. A free kick to Liverpool.
48' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Paul Tierney saw the whole situation. Brentford have a free kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Thomas Frank probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Vitaly Janelt. He is replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' Paul Tierney has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45+5' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) lets fly with a crisp shot from inside the box after picking up a lofted pass from Trent Alexander-Arnold, but the ball goes just over the bar.

45+3' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Mark Flekken, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
45+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ben Mee (Brentford) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
44' Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul after Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) hacks down one of his opponents. Brentford have a free kick.
42' The linesman raises his flag. Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is adjudged offside.

41' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Paul Tierney has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Brentford win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
39' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Darwin Nunez tees up Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Mark Flekken.
39' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
37' Joel Matip (Liverpool) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
35' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
33' Looks like Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
32' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
32' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Liverpool, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
30' It must be a yellow card. It is. Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
30' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Christian Norgaard (Brentford) for his blatant foul.
29' The goal by Liverpool won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
28' The Liverpool players joy may have been justified, because referee Paul Tierney is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
27' A goal, which was scored by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), was disallowed due to offside.
27' The linesman makes the right call and Liverpool will have a corner.
27' Ben Mee (Brentford) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
25' The game is interrupted now, Ben Mee (Brentford) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and it's Ben Mee (Brentford) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Liverpool will take a free kick near the side line.
24' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Liverpool players look gutted.
23' Attention! Referee Paul Tierney straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
22' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
19' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
17' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is penalised for a foul. Paul Tierney had a clear view and blows his whistle. Brentford win a free kick.
17' The referee awards a corner and Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) goes over to take it.

16' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Mark Flekken is alert and denies him with a nice save. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
13' The resulting corner, taken by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), comes to nothing.

13' A lofted cross from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
12' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a free kick to Liverpool in a dangerous position.
10' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
8' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Cody Gakpo, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
7' Liverpool take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
6' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
5' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
5' Ben Mee (Brentford) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
4' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
4' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Liverpool.
2' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
1' The first half has started.
Brentford will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Paul Tierney.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
